meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构查找并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常常要成批改动代码或统一代码风格。
copy.tagline_en: Find code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely refactor code patterns across many files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按代码结构而非文本搜索和改写代码,比如把 console.log 改成 logger.info、去掉 as any。它会先预览改动位置,确认后再修改文件;也能扫描 YAML 规则。
howto.when: 当你要求按代码结构而非文本查找或改写代码,比如找出特定形状的函数、把 console.log 换成 logger.info、扫描 YAML 规则时触发。目标若是字符串、注释、文件名等文本,则改用 grep/rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: Claude 用 ast-grep 按结构搜索并列出位置。

say.text: 把仓库里所有 console.log 改成 logger.info,先预览
say.note: 先 dry-run 展示改动,确认后再实际改写。

say.text: 扫描 src 并应用 YAML 规则
say.note: 运行 sg scan,展示违反规则的位置。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can search and rewrite code by structure (not text), e.g., turning console.log into logger.info or removing 'as any'. It previews changes before applying them, and can run YAML rules for bulk scans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find/rewrite code by structure, e.g., shaped functions, console.log→logger.info, or scanning YAML rules. For text targets (strings, comments, filenames), use grep/rg instead.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter
say_en.note: Searches by structure and lists locations.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log to logger.info in the repo, preview first
say_en.note: Dry-run first; apply only after you confirm.

say_en.text: Scan src and apply the YAML rules
say_en.note: Runs sg scan and shows violations.
